data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Backward-compat degradation path — absence of .reconciler-phase-gate.ops is RECOVERABLE degradation, not a failure. Behavior: (a) gate-content check on .reconciler-phase-gate proceeds normally; (b) operator-audit query against .reconciler-phase-gate.ops returns ops_log_available=false in output JSON; (c) emit WARNING (not failure) on stderr noting ops-log unavailability; (d) overall check_phase_gate exit code reflects only the gate-content match (0=match, 2=mismatch/missing-gate). Add RED test for degradation path: gate-file present + ops-file absent → exit 0 with stderr WARNING + ops_log_available=false in output.
